newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 200 mln lire of Italy BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 200 mln lire of Italy BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allotted 200 million lire worth of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.359 trillion lire at the open auction for the November 1, 2006 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of bonds on offer.
The auction price was set at 104.85 from 102.80 at the previous BTP sale on December 30 and the gross yield was 7.17 against 7.47 percent and net yield 6.20 from 6.49 percent.
